note: people_id to VoteApp candidate id for the Idaho Legislature, LegiScan session 2168. Every person in the session file has an entry, so a null is a reviewed decision rather than a gap the resolver has yet to reach. Seats come from LegiScan's `district` field, never from `role`, which LegiScan has been seen to contradict. Idaho splits each of its 35 legislative districts into two House seats lettered A and B, so a House seat reads HD-014A rather than a plain district number and the automatic seat-agreement check cannot fire on it; every House proposal was instead checked by hand against the district number and chamber in the candidate's own candidacy string, and all but one agreed.
